title: Conversation inbox
idea: Conversation inbox: A readable thread list and selected conversation preserve recipient identity and unresolved message state.
audience: People who need to handle conversations within a product-web surface.
avoidWhen: A shared inbox could expose private conversations to unauthorized viewers.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic conversation layout through its handle conversations priority and explicit commitment contract: Queued, sent, delivered and read states remain distinct and evidence-based.
navigation: Conversation inbox keeps the current handle conversations context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A readable thread list and selected conversation preserve recipient identity and unresolved message state.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to handle conversations; people manage several related discussions.
composition.priority: Queued, sent, delivered and read states remain distinct and evidence-based.

imagery.role: Support the actual handle conversations context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Open one thread at a time and restore inbox filters on return.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the conversation inbox structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no handle conversations content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Queued, sent, delivered and read states remain distinct and evidence-based.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized handle conversations content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Queued, sent, delivered and read states remain distinct and evidence-based.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active handle conversations context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
